## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `49440c7801a8df9b62e420f41f21a2ebd1a6e81d`
Local-runs: none
Scope: skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md, skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md + scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs
Security-touching: no

Inputs read: card #37988 (body, 3 comments, dev report 7235781864), folded card #38128 (body, 2 comments), PR #38205 (body, 6 files, net diff against merge-base `4f7aa88a`, which is `origin/main`), and the check-runs on the head. Cited code was read on `main`, nothing was built or run.

### ① Derived judgments

- No accept-set change. The diff touches no schema, validator, lint rule or runtime file; nothing an author can write is accepted or refused differently. Right.
- Public surface: the published text of `@objectstack/skills` (two files) changes. Right, and carried by the changeset.
- `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`: the `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` ceiling tightens 6333 to 6328 and the `relationships.md` ceiling holds at 4181. Both agree with the blobs at the head: 25339 bytes, `ceil((25339 - 27) / 4)` = 6328; 16721 bytes, `ceil(16721 / 4)` = 4181 (base blobs 25359 and 16724). No raise, so no ruling is owed. Right.
- `content/docs/**` ships in no package. Right.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/37988-skills-i18n-packages-group.md` declares `@objectstack/skills` patch. The diff publishes skill wording only, so patch is the right level. `Clause-②: no` on the PR body and the changeset is right: no accept set narrows and no published schema moves. `Metadata-protocol: none` is right.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: empty. Nothing to answer.
- Dev flag, "Setup's package list fallback to `manifest.name` not verified by running": answered by reading. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PackagesPage.tsx` (l.843, l.1620-1625) and `StudioPackageSwitcher.tsx` (l.73 `pkg.name || pkg.id`, l.93 `appLabel || packageName(p)`) do what the text says, including the switcher keeping an app's label.
- Dev flag, "the `os lint` spelling of the warning not verified by running": the `os lint` spelling is right (`packages/cli/src/commands/lint.ts` l.79, `i18n/missing-` plus the `package` bucket of `i18n-coverage.ts` l.410). The attribution of that id to `os i18n check` is not; see S1.
- Dev flag, PR #38196 edits other lines of the same SKILL.md: outside this review. The i18n ratchet row is re-measured by whichever lands second.
- Dev flag, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` not measured locally: the diff has no built code; `Build Core` on the head is green.
- SQL push-down: no code path, no query, no id materialisation in the diff. Nothing to find.
- Check-runs on the head: every completed run is success or skipped, none failed. One re-run of `Check Changeset` (started 07:15Z, after the PR body edit) was still in progress at read time; the earlier run of the same check on this head concluded success.

### ④ Design judgment

**`skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md`**

The `packages` group, against `packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts` l.2551-2592 on `main`:
- "`name` / `description` by `manifest.id`": holds. The member is a record keyed by `MANIFEST_ID_PATTERN` holding a strict object of `name` and `description`.
- "the dotted id one key": holds. The key is one record key, and the docblock says a client reads the row by direct property access, never a dot path. The example `packages: { 'com.acme.crm': { name: '客户关系' } }` passes the id grammar (`address-grammar.ts` l.70).
- "a locale with no row shows `manifest.name`": holds, in the spec docblock and both console readers named under ③.
- "until that package's own bundle carries it": coverage is judged over the merged bundles (`mergeTranslationBundles`), so a row in any bundle of the stack clears the warning. The package's own bundle is the placement the spec docblock prescribes. See N2.

S1 (should-fix) — the group text says "`os i18n check` warns `i18n/missing-package`". On `main` that id is produced by `os lint` alone: `foldCoverageIssues` in `packages/cli/src/commands/lint.ts` l.79 builds `i18n/missing-` plus the source. `packages/cli/src/commands/i18n/check.ts` prints the missing key (`packages.com.acme.crm.name`) and the sentence "Package ... missing translation for locale ...", and its `--json` carries `source: "package"`; the string `i18n/missing-package` appears in neither. This is the first `i18n/missing-*` id the skill names, and it is the one sentence the card's acceptance ("names the `i18n/missing-package` warning and how to clear it") rests on. An agent told this looks for the id in `os i18n check` output and does not find it. The fix is to name `os lint` as the reporter of the id, with `os i18n check` listing the same gap by key; it costs no tokens. The two docs pages carry the same attribution ("`os i18n check` and `os lint` report a missing one as the warning `i18n/missing-package`") and should take the same wording in the fix; they are the lane seat's remainder and are not graded here.

The `_relatedLists.{list}` row, against the object read on `main` (PR #38085, `ee2ffca3`):
- "re-state the entry, shown, with a `label`: the owner's own keeps its translation": holds. `hasRelatedListTitleOffBase` in `packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts` (l.3717) treats a label equal to the packaged base's as not diverged, and such a title reads the deployment catalog, which holds the owner's row.
- "any other reads this key from the `.custom` package's own bundle": holds. `objectPairRelatedListsBundleOf` (l.3688) hands on only `objects.{name}._relatedLists` of the pair of the package the object's base ships in, at the same key. An entry the base does not label counts as diverged, so a label added where the owner had none is covered too.
- "(`os i18n check` expects it)": holds; the `i18n-standard.mdx` `_relatedLists` row on `main` and the `related-list-titles.ts` fold say the same.
- The refusal half of the sentence (`os validate` refuses the key where the arrangement re-states without a `label` or hides the entry) is unchanged and still true.

The cuts, judged for what a reader still needs:
- The six-shape list in the translation-reference paragraph becomes one sentence pointing at the `_actions` row. Each of the six is conditioned in that row: the outcome, the `resultDialog.fields` and `preflight.fields` paths, the `columns` field and column paths, the `resultDialog` copy, `cancelText`, and `submitText`, whose row now says "a non-empty `params`", the one nuance only the list carried. The new sentence keeps the severity ("The same error") and the reason. Nothing needed is lost.
- The "one TranslationData per locale" code comment repeated the sentence that introduces the example. Nothing lost; the example still passes the skill example checks on the head.

**`skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md`**

- The `relatedLists` bullet now reads "re-state the entry, shown, with the owner's `label`, or its own, translated at that key in the `.custom` package's bundle". Both routes hold against the same code as above, and the key is the one the bullet names two lines up. The antecedent of "its own" is loose; see N1.
- Cuts: "(cascade delete)" in the type table (the Delete Behaviors section states `cascade` or `restrict`, so the cut also removes an overstatement), "to aggregate" after the roll-up intro, and the grid example's "as above" comment. Nothing a reader needs is lost.

**`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`** (implementing file)

- Both rows agree with the measured blobs, as computed under ①. The two comment blocks describe the additions and the cuts as the diff makes them, sentence by sentence. The trailing history note on the i18n row ("then -5 (was 6333)") is right.

Nits:
- N1 (nit) — `relationships.md`: "or its own" can be read as the entry's or the owner's own; "or the arrangement's own" would be unambiguous. The SKILL.md row says it clearly.
- N2 (nit) — SKILL.md: "until that package's own bundle carries it" names the prescribed placement, not the only one that clears the warning; coverage reads the merged bundles. Accepted as written.

One should-fix (S1), no must-fix. The record passes the contract as taught, and S1 earns a delta review of its fix on the new head.

**VERDICT: PASS**

Delta review of the record on `49440c78`. Judged: the one commit `626d0d95` (`git diff 49440c78 626d0d95`, six files, +28 / -24), the PR body as it now reads, and the check-runs on this head. The rest of the diff against `main` is unchanged from the reviewed head and stays covered by that record. Cited code was read on `main`; nothing was built or run.

S1: closed
N1: closed

### ① Derived judgments

- No accept-set change in the delta: wording in two skill files, two docs pages, the changeset body and two ratchet rows. Right.
- `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`: the `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` row is now 6315 and the `relationships.md` row 4179. Both agree with the blobs at this head: 25285 bytes, `ceil((25285 - 27) / 4)` = `ceil(25258 / 4)` = 6315; 16714 bytes, `ceil(16714 / 4)` = 4179. Both rows move down, so no raise and no ruling is owed. Right.

### ② Semver level

Unchanged: `@objectstack/skills` patch, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`. The delta publishes skill wording only, so each still holds. The changeset body now states the corrected attribution and the new row values (6333 to 6315, 4181 to 4179), matching the tree.

### ③ Boundary flags

- No new dev flag and no `open_questions` entry in the delta.
- SQL push-down: no code path in the delta. Nothing to find.
- Check-runs on this head: every completed run is success or skipped, none failed. One re-run of `Check Changeset` (started 07:45Z, after the PR body edit) was in progress at read time; the earlier run of the same check on this head concluded success.

### ④ Design judgment

**`skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md`**

- S1: the group text now reads "`os lint` warns `i18n/missing-package` (`os i18n check` lists the key) until that package's own bundle carries it". This agrees with `main`: `foldCoverageIssues` in `packages/cli/src/commands/lint.ts` l.79 builds the id, and `packages/cli/src/commands/i18n/check.ts` prints the missing key and never the id. Closed.
- New cut: the two remaining code-comment tails of the first example ("assemble the locales into one bundle…", "…and register it on the stack"). The sentence introducing the example says "one `TranslationData` per locale, assembled with `defineTranslationBundle` and registered on the stack", and the file-path comments stay, so nothing a reader needs is lost. The example's code is untouched.

**`skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md`**

- N1: the bullet now reads "with the owner's `label`, or the arrangement's own, translated at that key in the `.custom` package's bundle". Unambiguous, and still true against `objectPairRelatedListsBundleOf` in `packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts`. Closed.
- New cut: "places the lines and" in the inline-entry example's comment. The paragraph directly above says the group "draws the child's table at its place in the record's details and in the parent's entry form", so the comment restated it. Nothing lost; "the group holds no fields" stays.

**`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`** (implementing file)

- Both rows agree with the head blobs, as computed under ①. The comment blocks name the cuts as the delta makes them (three comment tails in the i18n example; four phrases in `relationships.md`), and the trailing history notes ("then -18 (was 6333)", "then -2 (was 4181)") are right.

The two docs pages (the lane seat's remainder, not graded) now carry the same attribution as the skill: `os lint` reports the id, `os i18n check` lists the gap by its key.

N2 is left as written, an accepted deviation, as the first record allowed.

No must-fix, no should-fix.

Both ratchet rows move down to the measured values (6333 → 6315, 4181 → 4179); no row is raised.

Delta 7236174046 at this head is a PASS: `S1: closed`, `N1: closed`; N2 (the warning clears from any bundle of the stack, the skill names the package's own) is an accepted deviation, because the own bundle is where the spec docblock places the row. Both transcripts pass `verify-review-tier`; the seat adopts the records.

## 维护者速读
- **改了什么：** 两张卡合成一个 PR，只改翻译技能、数据技能的关联规则和两页翻译文档：
  - 软件包名称按语言显示（#35513 新加的 packages 组）：怎么写、点号 id 是一个键、没写时回退到 manifest 名称；`os lint` 会报 i18n/missing-package 警告，`os i18n check` 按键列出缺口。
  - 定制包里相关列表标签页的标题：照抄 owner 原标题仍沿用 owner 的译文；写自己的标题时从定制包自己的翻译里读（#37622 合入后的新行为）。
- **影响：** 只改技能和文档文字，不改产品行为。两份技能文件的字数还降了一点，棘轮行按实测下调，没有抬上限。
- **请你留意：** 复核第一轮指出警告是 `os lint` 报的、不是 `os i18n check`，已改正并复核通过。另一个待批的 #38196 也改了这份翻译技能的另一段，两者能干净合并，后落地的那个会先合 main 再进队。
- **审核：** 契约审核（最高档）首轮 PASS 带一个应改项（7235862784），修正后 delta PASS（7236174046），无遗留。席位 L1 ACCEPT 在本评论前一条。
- **要你做什么：** 需要你批准后才能合并。撤回这一次合并即恢复原样。
